caption: The drawing features a circular, shallow dish or plate positioned centrally against a plain, off-white background. The dish is rendered in tones of brown, ochre, and gold, with visible hints of green and bluish hues highlighting certain decorative elements. In the center of the plate, there is a symmetrical arrangement of stylized leaves and stems radiating outward from a circular central motif, forming a floral design. The leaves are shaded in green and brown, with visible veining and curling shapes. Around the rim of the plate is an inscription in a dark color, possibly a form of writing or decorative text, following the curve along the entire circumference. The shadow and shading suggest a three-dimensional roundness to the plate. The plain background draws focus to the centrally placed object without any other items or scenery present. Near the lower right of the plate's outer edge, there is a small, neat signature or label inscribed on the background.
title: Pa. German Plate
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
